summary: A canvasser points out where the name, address and signature go before the resident writes.
realLife: A petition guide tells circulators to show signers where first name, last name, address and signature belong before they start writing.
sources: Common Cause Ohio, petition circulator FAQ, undated: https://commoncause.org/ohio/?p=484
inGame: petition sheet record; the signer's own fields; circulator witnessing

turns.pulledBy: a registered voter at the right address
turns.writesBack: the sheet gains a valid line

turns.turn: The resident signs in the wrong box or an unreadable hand
